description: This file contains a Kotlin class implementation of a Tic Tac Toe game engine, including game logic, score tracking, and move handling, designed to be UI-framework agnostic.

classes.name: TicTacToeGame
classes.description: Main class encapsulating the game logic for Tic Tac Toe, including state management, move playing, game status evaluation, and AI move selection.

methods.name: resetBoard
methods.description: Resets the game board to an initial empty state while preserving the scores.

methods.name: resetAll
methods.description: Resets both the game board and the accumulated scores.

methods.name: playAt
methods.description: Attempts to make a move at the specified board index, updating game state accordingly.

methods.name: playComputerMove
methods.description: Executes a move for the computer player if applicable.

methods.name: getWinner
methods.description: Returns the current winner, if any.

methods.name: getWinningLine
methods.description: Returns the indices of the winning line, if any.

methods.name: isDraw
methods.description: Checks if the game has ended in a draw.

methods.name: isGameOver
methods.description: Determines whether the game has concluded either by win or draw.
